spec.title: PV payback
spec.description: Linear annualisation from days with positive home consumption. Partial years are seasonally biased. Payback is an estimate. No finite payback period is shown for non-positive annual savings.

spec.title: Driving costs — $vehicle
spec.description: Distance = maximum minus minimum daily odometer in the selected period. Session averages are time averages, not energy-weighted. Consumption includes charging losses; unrecorded charging is excluded.

spec.title: Battery
spec.description: Daily SoC aggregates outside 0–100% are excluded. Historical aggregates contain invalid readings; affected days have no valid daily extreme here.

spec.title: Electricity balance
spec.description: Unweighted mean of daily average tariffs is used as a benchmark for dynamic-tariff savings.

properties.value: Saved energy price due to dynamic tariff

spec.title: Average of top 5 days per month

spec.expr:
label_replace(
  avg(
    topk(
      5,
      last_over_time(pvEnergyDaily[$__range])
    ) by(year,month)
  ) by(year,month),
  "monthOfYear",
  "$1",
  "month",
  ".*-(..)"
)
